goal: Investigate model mismatch within a bounded thermal experiment budget.

revision_semantics.register_revision: Stage a provisional fitted candidate for testing, not acceptance or causal identification.
revision_semantics.confirmation: To test a fitted candidate: register_revision first, then propose_experiment on its returned model_id with kind confirmation.
revision_semantics.verdict: Only measured confirmation supports or rejects a staged revision on that tested input.

decision.rationale: Compare bounded candidates on observed evidence initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 before consuming experiments; training BIC favors linear (-1854.6) over quadratic_loss (-1842.9) and sensor_lag (-1815.3) with similar RMSE ~0.07C, so stage linear provisional fit first; fitting is not confirmation or causation.

Training fits on initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 favor linear BIC -1854.6 over quadratic_loss -1842.9 and sensor_lag -1815.3 but fitting is not confirmation; propose diagnostic sustained-both high-power test of initial model to seek measured mismatch before staging acceptance.

decision.rationale: Compare bounded candidate quadratic_loss on observed evidence initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 plus action-2 sustained-both (probe RMSE 0.082C no mismatch); training fit is provisional only, not mechanism or future accuracy, to compare against linear before consuming remaining experiments.

action-2 sustained-both probe showed no_mismatch_observed RMSE 0.082C; initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 training fits favor linear but fitting is not confirmation; propose diagnostic both-release to seek measured mismatch within budget before staging acceptance.

decision.rationale: Both action-2 sustained-both probe RMSE 0.082C and action-4 both-release probe RMSE 0.081C show no_mismatch_observed, but passing does not certify mechanism; prior fits only compared linear BIC -1854.6 vs quadratic -1842.9 vs sensor_lag -1815.3 on initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 and quadratic BIC -2446.07 on action-2+initials. Fit sensor_lag on full observed evidence before consuming remaining 2 experiments; fitting is provisional only, not causation or future accuracy.

Compare bounded candidates on full observed evidence initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 plus action-2 sustained-both RMSE 0.082C and action-4 both-release RMSE 0.081C both no_mismatch_observed; sensor_lag provisional fit exists on same evidence but linear not yet compared on full set; stage linear provisional fit before consuming remaining 2 experiments; fitting is not confirmation, mechanism, or future accuracy.

Compare remaining bounded family on full observed evidence initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 plus action-2 sustained-both RMSE 0.082C and action-4 both-release RMSE 0.081C both no_mismatch_observed; linear BIC -3063.97 beats sensor_lag BIC -2943.88 on same evidence but quadratic_loss not yet compared on full set; stage provisional quadratic_loss fit before consuming 2 remaining experiments; fitting is not confirmation, mechanism, or future accuracy.
